v7_candidates.text: Hello Ms Reynolds, your identity checks have cleared and we can open your Premier Savings Account. Because you plan to deposit M$35,000 in cash, we are required by law to ask a few questions before accepting it: 1) What is the source of these funds (e.g. the business or sale that generated them)? 2) Are these funds entirely your own, or are you depositing them on behalf of anyone else? If on behalf of someone else, we need their identity details and a beneficial-owner declaration. 3) Can you confirm the source-of-funds documents already on file still reflect this income? We will also file a mandatory large cash report for this deposit. Thank you for your cooperation.
